basic_info.description: Welcome to 509-511 44th Avenue, a well-maintained duplex just blocks from Ocean Beach and Lands End in San Francisco's sought-after Outer Richmond neighborhood. This charming property features two spacious, light-filled units with a tunnel entrance to two separate units - ideal for owner-occupants, multigenerational families, or savvy investors. Both units are identical, each offering 1,300 square feet of living spaces, boasting 2 large bedrooms, 1 full bathroom with shower and tub, a generous living room and formal dining area perfect for relaxing and entertaining. Each unit also includes a sizable kitchen with ample cabinet and counter space, designed for everyday living. A spacious two-car garage with room for storage and laundry, along with a low-maintenance backyard ready for gardening, pets and play, completes this rare gem. Nestled on a quiet street, just steps to Lands End Trail, Ocean Beach, Sutro Heights, Lincoln Park and Golf, this duplex is also just a short stroll from local cafes, transit, and highly rated schools. Whether you live in one unit and rent the other, host extended family, or invest in a prime coastal property, this home offers flexibility, charm, and an unbeatable San Francisco location.
